About GuroPrep

GuroPrep is a free lesson-preparation workspace for Philippine public school teachers. It helps you prepare lesson plans, worksheets, answer keys and weekly prep packs faster, so you can spend less time on paperwork and more time with your learners.

What you can do

  • Choose a grade, subject and competency, then prepare a lesson plan, worksheet and answer key.
  • Edit everything on the page, then download editable Word (DOCX) or PowerPoint (PPTX) files, or print.
  • Use the Classroom tools for weekly planning, differentiated practice and offline packs.

GuroPrep prepares drafts. You are the teacher: always review and adapt the content for your learners before using it in class.

Not an official DepEd product

GuroPrep is built to follow the Department of Education (DepEd) curriculum guides and budgets of work, and links to DepEd sources where it can. However, GuroPrep is an independent project. It is not made, approved or endorsed by DepEd.

Always check competency wording and codes against your school's official Curriculum Guide and follow your school's and division's instructions.

Privacy

  • No account needed. GuroPrep does not ask for your name, email or school to use the lesson workspace.
  • Your lessons stay on your device. Saved lessons are stored only in the browser you are using. They are not uploaded to our server.
  • Keep a backup. If you clear your browser data, change browsers or change phones, your saved lessons will be gone. Use Download lesson backup regularly, then Import lesson backup on a new device.
  • No learner data, please. Do not type learners' full names, photos or records into GuroPrep.
  • Like most websites, our server keeps short technical logs (such as IP address and pages requested) to keep the site running and secure. Some classroom tools load a PDF helper from a public content network (cdnjs).
  • Usage statistics without cookies. We count page visits and simple actions (for example, "a Grade 5 Mathematics lesson was prepared") to see which tools teachers need. We do not use cookies or advertising trackers, and we do not store IP addresses for statistics: visits are counted with a code that changes every week and cannot identify you.
  • Write with AI. If you use this optional button, the competency, objectives and your own idea are sent to OpenAI to make a draft. We do not store this text. Do not type learners' names.
  • Teacher applications. If you apply to teach with Move Up Academy, the information you send is kept only by Move Up Academy to contact you about teaching jobs. Ask us any time to delete it.
  • Files you choose to download or share (for example, a feedback file or a Teacher originals submission pack) are created on your device. They are only shared if you send them to someone yourself.

We follow the principles of the Philippine Data Privacy Act of 2012 (Republic Act No. 10173). If we add teacher accounts in the future, we will update this page before collecting any personal information.

Who makes GuroPrep?

GuroPrep is made by GuroWorks, the team behind Move Up Academy, an English school with a campus in Cebu. We built GuroPrep to give back to Filipino teachers. If you would like to earn extra by teaching English online, see Teach English online with Move Up Academy.

Is it really free?

Yes. The lesson workspace and classroom tools are free for teachers. GuroPrep is currently in a pilot with a small group of teachers, so some grades and subjects have more material than others. More content is being added step by step.
